datasets.name: CreditInfo
datasets.sql:
select
  ID,
  Numberofcredit ,
  CreditLineAmount,
  Name,
  VAL_NAME,
  Currency,
  BoorowerID,
  obligation
from
  CM_ACTIVE
where ID=:ID

datasets.name: TrancheAccounts
datasets.sql:
SELECT   id AS accid, kli_id, acc_no AS accountnumber, NAME AS accountname
    FROM account
   WHERE (    kli_id = :kli_id and close_dat is null
          AND bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                            FROM cm_aginfo
                           WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                              FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                             WHERE g.iname = 'ClientAccs'))
         )

                                           FROM cm_accountgroups g
                                          WHERE g.iname = 'InternalBankAccs'))

ORDER BY kli_id, accountnumber*/

datasets.name: CustAccount
datasets.sql:
select 
      BOOROWERACCID 
   from 
      CM_ACCOUNTS
 where CreditID=:CreditID

datasets.name: TranchesData
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, creditid, tranchedate, trancheamount
  FROM cm_tranches
WHERE CreditID=:CreditID
ORDER BY tranchedate DESC

datasets.name: OracleDataSet1
datasets.sql:
SELECT     a.id AS accid, kli_id, a.acc_no||' '||a.name AS accountnumber, a.NAME AS accountname,a.acc_no
    FROM account a ,cm_usergroups u,cm_active_credits p   where a.acc_no=u.acc_no and p.branchid=u.filial_id
    and u.id=p.usrgroup and  p.id=:creditid
